common_harness.base_framework: OpenHands SDK through ProWorkSim HarnessPort and WorldCore
common_harness.budget_scope: one shared cumulative input plus output pool, not per-member copies
common_harness.public_task_board: unchanged shared managed task metadata; not a private edge channel
common_harness.patch_use: fixed versions remain public under the existing harness; direct handoffs follow declared routes and incorporation always requires explicit managed merge
common_harness.public_tests: same confined repository public entrypoint and same-version evidence
common_harness.code_endpoint: unique final workspace of member_001 at the frozen closure boundary
common_harness.delivery_endpoint: last legal submission by member_001, separately evidenced and scored

public_task_pool.selection: All existing public identities; no historical scores or answer material read

specification.name: 集中负责人

member_001.title: 负责人兼集成者
member_001.instruction: Plan the repair, assign work through legal managed operations, coordinate findings, integrate received fixed patches and close delivery.

member_002.title: 仓库定位员
member_002.instruction: Locate relevant code and explain the suspected mechanism to the lead. Provide concrete paths and observations without accessing hidden materials.

member_003.title: 实现者
member_003.instruction: Implement the requested repair in your private workspace, validate it with permitted public tests and hand a fixed patch to the lead.

member_004.title: 质量复核者
member_004.instruction: Review the fixed candidate received from the lead, check the issue and public test evidence, then report concrete concerns to the lead.

notes: Four fixed agents, not MAGIS dynamic per-task developer creation.
Direct coordination between spokes must pass through the lead.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 职能流水线

member_001.title: 需求与集成
member_001.instruction: State issue requirements and acceptance questions using public evidence; later integrate the returned fixed artifact and close delivery.

member_002.title: 定位与方案
member_002.instruction: Translate requirements into a concrete repository diagnosis and implementation plan, with assumptions and affected interfaces.

member_003.title: 实现
member_003.instruction: Implement the agreed plan, publishing a fixed patch and concise change summary for the validation stage.

member_004.title: 测试与交接
member_004.instruction: Validate the received fixed artifact with public tests, report its source version and remaining concerns, and hand the result to integration.

notes: Single-role windows with instructed requirements/plan/patch/test handoffs.
The harness validates real artifact identities; a written stage summary is not test evidence.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 阶段对话链

member_001.title: 需求与交付
member_001.instruction: Clarify the issue with the designer and later integrate the explicitly returned patch. Keep final delivery tied to your tested version.

member_002.title: 设计与衔接
member_002.instruction: Discuss requirements with member_001 and implementation with member_003. Explicitly receive, merge and republish patches that travel through you.

member_003.title: 编码
member_003.instruction: Discuss design with member_002, implement a repair, and work with member_004 on tests. Return the fixed implementation through member_002.

member_004.title: 测试
member_004.instruction: Discuss the received implementation with member_003, run allowed public checks and return precise revision feedback along the same link.

inspiration: ChatDev phase and role dialogue chain
notes: Only adjacent pairs communicate directly; each pair alternates ordinary opportunities.
Fixed versions remain team-public; intermediary handoffs are not required to read them. Reading, explicit merging and directed communication are real work, not free relays.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 开发复核返修

member_001.title: 开发者甲兼集成
member_001.instruction: Coordinate implementation scope with the other developer, publish a fixed candidate for review, revise it and close integration.

member_002.title: 开发者乙
member_002.instruction: Implement a complementary part or investigate an alternative with the same issue information, request review and explicitly deliver patches to member_001.

member_003.title: 复核者甲
member_003.instruction: Review developer patches for correctness and issue coverage, using actual source and public evidence. Return actionable feedback to either developer.

member_004.title: 复核者乙
member_004.instruction: Independently review developer patches and edge cases, using allowed public tests when useful; communicate concerns directly to the responsible developer.

notes: Reviewers give evidence and feedback, not an external hidden-score oracle.
Common managed tool powers remain available; reviewer roles are instructions, not read-only ACLs.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 扁平同伴协作

member_001.title: 同伴甲兼交付出口
member_001.instruction: Self-organize with your peers using the task board and explicit messages. You have no managerial or extra visibility powers; integrate the agreed final code.

member_002.title: 同伴乙
member_002.instruction: Self-organize with the other peers, choose useful work from public information, and explicitly coordinate responsibilities and fixed patches.

member_003.title: 同伴丙
member_003.instruction: Self-organize with the other peers, choose useful work from public information, and explicitly coordinate responsibilities and fixed patches.

member_004.title: 同伴丁
member_004.instruction: Self-organize with the other peers, choose useful work from public information, and explicitly coordinate responsibilities and fixed patches.

notes: Fixed membership and turn order; only work allocation is self-organized.
member_001 is the common export address, not an elected or privileged manager.
specification.schedule_semantics: repeat fixed windows; round-robin within each window; skip non-runnable members without a world action; consume actual attempts only

specification.name: 专家会诊

member_001.title: 需求专家兼集成
member_001.instruction: Analyze issue semantics and success conditions, contribute to the joint discussion, and integrate the chosen implementation with explicit evidence.

member_002.title: 仓库与设计专家
member_002.instruction: Analyze repository structure and compatibility constraints; share reasoning and critique the implementation plan with the fixed expert group.

member_003.title: 实现专家
member_003.instruction: Participate in diagnosis, then implement the discussed approach in your workspace and publish an explicit fixed candidate for review and integration.

member_004.title: 验证专家
member_004.instruction: Contribute failure hypotheses and edge cases, then examine the received candidate and report actual public validation evidence to the group.

notes: No expert recruitment, member replacement or hidden-score voting.
Direct graph equals PEER; role specialization and staged activation are the treatment.

required_before_execution: Review the completed single-model budget and censoring evidence.
Select model identities, one common team budget and any further API cash cap.
Freeze task seeds, repeats, full execution matrix and resource authorization.
Ensure a comparable same-harness S1 reference; do not equate old revisions automatically.
Qualify a separately scoped isolated deployment without editing the running v064 sources.

measurement_contract.unit: one issue, one fixed organization and one shared team budget
measurement_contract.code: official grading of the unique locked final member_001 workspace
measurement_contract.delivery: last legal member_001 submission with its own same-version evidence
required_costs: reasoning and cache subsets without double counting
measurement_contract.mean_rule: Full-panel actual mean only with complete actual usage for the complete executed panel; interim subset mean carries its denominator and coverage.
measurement_contract.comparison: paired tasks, repository-aware uncertainty; roles, routes and scheduling are a combined organization treatment, not isolated graph causality
